node.title: Retained zeros lower the petal auxiliary degree and preserve exact support
node.statement: For disjoint R,T, every degree-<=d polynomial G vanishing on R factors uniquely as L_R Q with deg Q<=d-|R|. Dividing the received word by nonzero L_R on T preserves the exact agreement support. The constrained chart is Johnson-closed when a^2>(d-|R|)|T|; K4 needs only the reverse effective-degree range.
